items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I believe he was playing at them Tunks too, I think. I forget what man Mac was playing. Yeah. Nice little drummer.

ctx.x: Yeah. Who was he with? Do you remember that?
He was playing with some man around here. I believe he was playing at them Tunks too, I think. I forget what man Mac was playing. Yeah. Nice little drummer.

Oh, there was a woman who played piano for the rubber show, Ms. Margaret or something. Oh yeah, Margaret. Devoiney. Oh good, we got her name, you mentioned her before. Yeah, Devoiney. Couldn't think of her last name. Big family then, Devoiney's. Several of them played music, didn't they? Yeah, family then.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I just know him from him. ... I went to Fisk School right there, you know, and he stayed around the corner. I was just going to see him pretty regular.

ctx.x: Yeah, Mac, well that's who was to go with over them, you see. Yeah. But I went instead. I was sick then.
Did you see Mac much other than that?
